description: A shell script for performance testing and comparison of different git log grep engines with various regex patterns. It runs tests on large repositories, checks different grep engine configurations, and compares outputs to ensure consistency.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Sets up a large repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Checks out a working tree for testing.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Determines if a prerequisite is met, e.g., if PCRE is available.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified engine and options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Asserts that a test succeeds with given commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
